units.locator: Article 16.2. Failure to declare goods or inaccurate declaration of goods
units.text: 1. The administrative fine imposed on individuals under the sanction in Part 1 of this Article is calculated using the value of goods for personal use moved by individuals across the customs border of the Eurasian Economic Union. Where individuals fail to declare such goods whose value exceeds the value limits within which goods for personal use may be imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union free of customs duties and taxes, the value of the goods for personal use is used after deduction of those value limits. Where individuals fail to declare goods that are not goods for personal use, or goods in respect of which a decision has been taken that they are not goods for personal use, the administrative fine is calculated on the basis of their market value determined in accordance with Part 2 of Article 27.11 of this Code, without deducting the value limits within which goods for personal use may be imported into the customs territory of the Eurasian Economic Union free of customs duties and taxes.
